Returns & Refunds: Eligible products can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn, in original packaging, and accompanied by a valid receipt or order reference ID. Refunds are credited back to the original payment method within 5-7 business days upon warehouse inspection.
Order Delivery: Standard shipping typically takes 3 to 5 business days depending on customer location. Real-time tracking updates and carrier details are dispatched via email immediately after dispatch.
Payment Dispute: If a transaction failure or double-charge occurs, funds are automatically audited and reversed by the payment gateway. Manual dispute claims are reviewed within 24 to 48 hours by the finance department.
Damaged Item: Items arriving damaged or defective qualify for an immediate replacement or full refund. Customers must provide photo verification of the defect within 48 hours of delivery to initiate an expedited waiver.
